newsitem.title: NEPAL: Nepali princess to marry a commoner.
newsitem.headline: Nepali princess to marry a commoner.

text.p: Princess Sruti, second child of Nepal's King Birendra, is due to marry a commoner in May, the Narayanhiti royal palace said on Thursday.
A palace statement said the wedding of the princess to bank employee Gorakh Rana would be on May 8 and 9.
Sruti, 20, is the second of the three children of King Birendra, the world's only Hindu monarch. Her two brothers, including 25-year-old Crown Prince Dipendra, are yet to be married.
King Birendra recently marked 25 years on the throne.
